difficulty_reason: Prove a surjection F -> G of quasi-coherent O_X-modules induces a canonical closed immersion Quot_{G/X/B} -> Quot_{F/X/B}: with K = ker(F -> G), right exactness of pullbacks makes K_T -> F_T -> G_T -> 0 exact for all T, so a G_T-quotient determines an F_T-quotient - the transformation of functors; it is a closed immersion by the F-zero-closed lemma, the image condition being vanishing of K_{T'} -> Q_{T'} after pullback.
